$comment: ACCEPTED STRENGTH STATE, per lift, in Pelland Table 4 fractional sets.
Same contract as coverage-baseline.json: a gate expected to fail cannot signal a regression, so this
records what was accepted and gym-strength.mjs fails only on movement away from it.
RE-ACCEPTED 2026-09-01, and the reason is a real trade rather than a tidy-up.
The previous baseline was taken from git 2c83178, the programme live BEFORE the 2026-08-31 rebuild.
That programme no longer exists, so it could no longer signal anything about the one that replaced
it. A baseline pointing at a dead programme is the mirror of the failure this file exists to stop.
WHAT MOVED, AND WHY IT WAS ACCEPTED. Restoring the two frontal-plane exercises the rebuild had
DELETED (lateral-bound, which he performed 2026-08-30, the day before the rebuild dropped it; and
db-lateral-lunge, loadable direct adductor work whose cue opens "This is the sideways movement you
asked for") raised BB Back Squat from 19.5 to 20.5 and Bulgarian Split Squat from 19 to 20.5. Both
are ABOVE the old baseline. That is the documented mechanism, not a surprise: nearly every
lower-body lift here shares the glutes, so any lower-body set raises the fractional count of all of
them.
IT WAS ACCEPTED BECAUSE THE COST IS ON A FLAT PART OF THE CURVE AND THE GAIN IS NOT. Both lifts sit
about 16 fractional sets past the point where Pelland stops finding detectable strength increments,
so 17.5 against 20.5 is noise on the outcome axis. What it buys is the ONLY sideways work in the
week: measured 2026-09-01, the programme had ZERO direct abductor or frontal-plane sets across all
16 blocks, while equipment.json cites Comert and Gruber 2025 for loaded frontal-plane work as the
replacement for the banded walks that were cut, and that replacement had never shipped.
THE REAL COST IS THE CLOCK, and it should be stated in those units: 95 prescribed sets to 98, which
at his measured 4.0 minutes per logged set is about 12 minutes a week.
WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS THE WRONG CALL: if he reports the sessions are running long. The reversal is to
cut the lateral lunge, not the bound, because the bound is the one he was already doing.
fromProgram: content/gym/program.json as shipped 2026-09-01, after his email rulings
